result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The scoping tests in `codeanalyzer` pass, but I didn't add tests that check the new matches (`.htm`, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js`, `build-gradle.js`).

- **Generated HTML rules (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the extension pattern was `(html|html|xhtml)`, with `html` listed twice. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match as well as the old `.html` and `.xhtml`.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML rule:** the file pattern `.*/[.]xml` only matched a file named `.xml`. It is now `.*[.]xml`.
- **`// Generated by` JavaScript rule:** the file pattern `.*/[.]js` is now `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle JavaScript rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I changed only the file-name patterns, not the content patterns or line limits. Hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of those scopes because the content patterns are unchanged.
